name: sveltekit-shop
title: Terracotta Supply – plant-pot shop (SvelteKit 2 + Svelte 5)
description: Fictional plant-pot e-commerce site: product catalogue, cookie-stored cart, checkout that writes orders to a JSON store, customer account area and an admin product CRUD, all built on SvelteKit form actions with a server-side cookie session resolved in hooks.server.ts.

env.name: ORIGIN
env.description: Public origin of the site (scheme://host[:port]) as browsers see it. SvelteKit rejects form-action POSTs whose Origin header differs from it (403), so set it to the real public URL (e.g. https://shop.example.com) for anything other than localhost access. `npm start`/the image default it to http://localhost:3012 with a warning.

env.name: PORT
env.description: HTTP port of the adapter-node server.

env.name: COOKIE_SECURE
env.description: Set "true" behind HTTPS so session/cart cookies get the Secure flag (keep false for plain-HTTP smoke tests).

env.name: DATA_DIR
env.description: Directory holding users.json, sessions.json, products.json and orders.json (auto-created and seeded on first request).

auth.description: Cookie `tc_session` holds an opaque id looked up in a server-side Map (persisted to data/sessions.json, 7-day TTL) by hooks.server.ts, which sets event.locals.user. Login/register/logout are SvelteKit form actions (POST /login?/login, /register?/register, /logout). Route-group layouts enforce access: (account) redirects anonymous users 303 to /login?next=..., (admin) additionally requires role admin (403 otherwise). Passwords are bcryptjs hashes.

persistence: JSON files in data/ (DATA_DIR): users.json, products.json (10 seeded pots), orders.json, sessions.json - created and seeded on first request, rewritten atomically on change. The cart lives client-side in the `tc_cart` cookie.
notes: Needs a writable DATA_DIR (Docker: mount a volume at /app/data). Set ORIGIN to the public URL or every form submission (login included) fails with 403 'Cross-site POST form submissions are forbidden'. For curl smoke tests send `Origin: http://localhost:3012` and `Accept: text/html` on action POSTs: e.g. `curl -c jar -H 'Origin: http://localhost:3012' -H 'Accept: text/html' -X POST 'http://localhost:3012/login?/login' -d 'email=shopper@terracotta.shop&password=Shop123!'` -> 303, then `curl -b jar http://localhost:3012/account` -> 200 (without the cookie: 303 to /login). Without `Accept: text/html` SvelteKit answers action POSTs with 200 + JSON ({"type":"redirect"|"failure",...}). Actions without fields (checkout, logout) still need a form-encoded body (`-d ''`), otherwise 415. `npm audit` lists 3 low advisories in transitive dev tooling only.
